title: Died in Ur Arms
label: Ruff Sqwad Recordings
format: Track on mixtape (Guns and Roses Volume. 2)

type.basis: Evidence specimen; its title and a 2020 essay suggest a sample of Cutting Crew's 1986 power ballad, not confirmed by a source.

sound.text: TRENCH (2020) mentions Cutting Crew's '(I Just) Died In Your Arms' as a recognisable sample in Ruff Sqwad's R&G tracks; the title suggests this track uses it, but no source states so. Made on FruityLoops (crew generally).
Afropop pairs it ('Dying in Your Arms') with 'Functions on the Low' as cuts reflecting the crew's 'genuine melodic gifts', borrowing a chipmunked house sample and a cheesy synth tone.

context.text: TRENCH (2020) recalls it on a 2007 Valentine's mix CD from the period when R&G (rhythm and grime) 'had fully arrived'.

rels.other: Cutting Crew - (I Just) Died In Your Arms

uncertainty: Production credit is the blanket mixtape credit (all tracks Rapid & Dirty Danger). No standalone 2000s vinyl release verified.
tracklist: Track 5 of Guns and Roses Volume. 2; instrumental later on White Label Classics (CD only) as 'Died in Your Arms'.
